name: Sikadur® Hex-300
tagline: HIGH-MODULUS, HIGH-STRENGTH, 2-PART EPOXY IMPREGNATING RESIN USED WITH SIKAWRAP STRUCTURAL STRENGTHENING SYSTEMS
summary: Sikadur® Hex-300 is a two-component 100% solids, moisture-tolerant, high strength, high modulus epoxy. Sikadur® Hex-300 is an unfilled primer or impregnation resin with an extra-long pot life and a slow curing speed. Sikadur® Hex-300 is compliant with the 2012 and 2009 International Building Codes (IBC) and the 1997 Uniform Building Code (UBC) per ICC-ES Evalutation Report ESR- 3288.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text:
2009 & 2012 International Building Codes (IBC)
1997 Uniform Building Code (UBC) per ICC-ES Evalutation Report ESR-3288.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 24 months from date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Density
items.text: 1.16 kg/l (component A+B mixed) (at +23 °C)

items.label: Viscosity
items.text:
Temperature | Viscosity
+15 °C | ~2,000 cps
+23 °C | ~700 cps
+40 °C | ~200 cps

items.label: System structure
items.text: Substrate primer - Sikadur®-330 / Sikadur® Hex-300. Impregnating/laminating resin - Sikadur® Hex-300. Structural strengthening fabric - SikaWrap® type to suit requirements.

items.text: ~ 3,500 MPa (+23 °C, 50 % R.H) ~ 4,130 MPa (+60 °C, 50 % R.H, post cured min. 48hrs) | (ASTM D-790)

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Mix entire unit, do not batch down

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +15 °C min. / +40 °C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3 °C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: < 4 % pbw

items.label: Pot Life
items.text:
Temperature | Potlife | Open time
+15 °C | ~6 hours | ~3 hours
+23 °C | ~4 hours | –
+40 °C | ~90 minutes | ~60 minutes
The potlife begins when the resin and hardener are mixed. It is shorter at high temperatures and longer at low temperatures. The greater the quantity mixed, the shorter the potlife. To obtain longer workability at high temperatures, the mixed adhesive may be divided into portions. Another method is to chill components A+B before mixing them (not below +5 °C).

items.label: Curing time
items.text: ~ 12–14 hours | (Tack Free)

items.label: Consumption
items.text: See the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® manual wet application" Ref. 850 41 03 and the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® saturator machine wet application" Ref 850 41 04. Guide: 0.4–1.0 kg/m2.

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: The substrate must be sound and of sufficient tensile strength to provide a minimum pull off strength of 1.5 N/mm2 or as per the requirements of the design specification ACI 440.2R, AS5100.8:2017 or Vic Roads Spec Section 688: 2018 . See also the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® manual wet application" Ref 850 41 03 and the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® saturator machine wet application" Ref 850 41 04.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: See the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® manual wet application" Ref 850 41 03 and the "Method Statement for SikaWrap® saturator machine wet application" Ref 850 41 04.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Pre-batched units: Mix components A+B together for at least 3 minutes at low speed. Avoid aeration while mixing. Then, pour the whole mix into a clean container and stir again for approx. 1 more minute at low speed to keep air entrapment at a minimum. Bulk packing, not pre-batched: Add the components in the correct proportions into a suitable mixing pail and stir correctly using an electric low speed mixer as above for pre-batched units.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all equipment immediately with Sika® Colma Cleaner. Cured material can only be removed mechanically.
